gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Noto Sans Glagolitic reads clearly down to small sizes, with round, open letters and a sturdy, tall lowercase body. Righteous is best loud, bowls filling the line; the body is best quiet.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic has lowercase counters as big as glass beads, and round forms that curve like open parentheses. Righteous keeps horizontals and verticals matched, a firm frame for all that roundness.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Blueprint-clean lettering, all constant line and bowls that fill the width. Righteous holds one constant line while Noto Sans Gujarati lets curved strokes end before they turn inward, leaving big openings.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gondi: Fun, but sturdy: Righteous has no hairlines anywhere in its alphabet. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi, with crayon-tall lowercase and terminals cut back to leave wide gaps, gives that fun a modern, spacious partner.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Noto Sans Gurmukhi keeps ascenders low and terminals pointing outward like tongs. Paragraph after paragraph it stays clean and steady, while uniform bars in Righteous set the pace above.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Righteous draws bowls that fill the line in a single bent-rod stroke, with no thick-thin swing at all. Noto Sans Hanunoo takes over below with open terminals, easing the loudness.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Modern and unfussy, Noto Sans Hebrew has a dominant midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Beneath Righteous, drawn like pencil that never presses harder, text would flow smoothly.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-hk: Fun and firm, Righteous bends a single rod into bowls that fill the line, with no stress in any curve. Noto Sans HK handles the quieter work: large lowercase, brush ends lifted before curves close.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aram: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic points the two ends of its c apart like pincers, with a short step to capitals. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic then reads smoothly in paragraphs, under Righteous's uniform line.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional: Righteous has no thin or thick strokes at all, just a bent-rod line with bowls filling the space. And Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian does the quieter job, with big open eyes and a deep middle band.
